summary_en: Progress update on capital cost and share price-conscious management framework. Specific targets and metrics not disclosed in first 2 pages; see attached detailed materials for full framework.
title_en: Updates on Initiatives to Realise Management Conscious of Capital Cost and Share Price (June 2026 Update)
translation_en_brief: Chino Corporation filed an update to its capital cost and share price-conscious management framework on 30 June 2026. The disclosure is a progress report on initiatives previously announced on 30 June 2025. The first two pages do not disclose specific quantitative targets, metrics, thresholds, or ROE/margin goals; full details are contained in the attached supplementary materials dated June 2026. The update addresses the company's ongoing commitment to aligning management decisions with capital cost awareness and shareholder value creation.
